reason: Booking and Airbnb scheduled messages plus my printed house-rules sheet already answer the Wi-Fi and check-in questions. My guests pay a lot for the villa and they expect me, not a chatbot, so I don't see what this adds.
objection: At my price level guests want a personal touch. If a guest gets a robot answer, or a wrong one about the pool or the gate, it looks cheap and it reflects on me and my reviews.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run in a comparable high-end villa where it clearly saved the owner messages while I'm abroad, without guests complaining it felt impersonal.
